args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation plans file, here is the recommended packing list:

- Clothing:
  • 3-4 tops/shirts
  • 2-3 pairs of shorts/pants
  • 1-2 swimsuits
  • 1-2 light sweaters for cooler evenings
  • 1-2 pairs of comfortable walking shoes
  • Sandals/flip flops
  • Dressier outfit for dinner at Alan Wong's

- Toiletries:
  • Toothbrush/toothpaste
  • Deodorant
  • Shampoo/conditioner
  • Soap
  • Razor/shaving cream
  • Makeup/makeup remover

- Electronics:
  • Smartphone
  • Laptop
  • Camera
  • Portable charger
  • Universal power adapter

- Miscellaneous:
  • Reef-safe sunscreen
  • Insect repellent
  • Beach towel
  • Water bottle
  • Snorkeling gear
  • Beach bag
  • Travel documents (passport, ID, etc.)

- Hawaii-specific items:
  • Light rain jacket
  • Collapsible umbrella
  • After-sun lotion
  • Insect repellent with DEET

- Activities:
  • Snorkeling gear
  • Surfboard rental information
  • Hiking boots
  • Water shoes
  • Beach umbrella

- Evening:
  • Dressier outfit for dinner at Alan Wong's
  • Light sweater for air-conditioned restaurants
  • Comfortable shoes for walking

- Essentials:
  • Prescription medication
  • Contact lenses/glasses
  • Wallet/credit cards
  • Travel adapter

- Notes:
  • Check the weather forecast before departure
  • Pack light layers for cooler mornings and evenings
  • Bring a small daypack for daily excursions

This packing list is based on the vacation plans for June 13-20. The weather is expected to be warm and sunny, with occasional rain showers. The activities planned include snorkeling at Molokini Crater, hiking in Haleakala National Park, and dinner at Alan Wong's.

---

Created by Emma Johnson for Blue Sparrow Tech's Hawaii vacation.
